reason: I already reorder my usual brand when it runs out and my drawer is full of half-used bottles, so I am not adding another one. Plain magnesium bisglycinate is fine, but I would not switch for it.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? And I have never heard of this brand.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I already follow showing it working for a few weeks, or a much cheaper trial box so I am not stuck with another half-used bottle.
